steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Next.js 15.5 (App Router) + TS strict + Tailwind v4 scaffolded; src/{components,core/{time,tree,stats},services/{supabase,ai},db,types,lib} with .gitkeep; Vitest + vitest.config.ts (@/* alias); .claude/settings.json safety hooks; placeholder page/layout. lint/build/test all pass.

steps.name: supabase-auth
steps.summary: Supabase magic-link auth via @supabase/ssr: services/supabase/{client,server,middleware}.ts (publishable key only, no service_role); root src/middleware.ts refreshes session + redirects unauthenticated users to /login (except /login, /auth/*); /login page (signInWithOtp), /auth/callback route (exchangeCodeForSession), temp signOut server action on home. lint/build/test pass.

steps.name: google-oauth
steps.summary: Added Google OAuth alongside magic link (ADR-011): /login now renders a 'Google로 로그인' button (signInWithOAuth provider:'google', redirectTo /auth/callback) above an '또는' divider, with the existing magic-link email form kept intact. Shared /auth/callback PKCE code exchange handles both flows unchanged; publishable key only, no service_role. lint/build/test pass.

steps.name: db-schema
steps.summary: Drizzle ORM schema (src/db/schema.ts) for the ADR-009 data model: nodes (self-referencing Area>Project>Task>Subtask tree, node_type/node_status pgEnums), time_logs, daily_reviews, category_stats (ADR-006 layer-2). Every table has user_id + RLS enabled with owner-only policies ((select auth.uid()) = user_id) for all of select/insert/update/delete via a DRY ownerPolicies() helper; InferSelect/Insert types exported. drizzle.config.ts + generated drizzle/0000_icy_prima.sql (publishable key only, no service_role; DATABASE_URL absent so push skipped). .env.example documents DATABASE_URL. lint/build/test/generate pass.

steps.name: panel-routes
steps.summary: Plan/Act/Review 3-panel skeleton (ADR-004, empty state). src/components/panels/{Plan,Act,Review}Panel.tsx are propless Server Components (title + short phase caption + 'Coming soon'). src/app/page.tsx now renders a light header (app name + reused signOut server action) above a responsive grid (grid-cols-1, md:grid-cols-3) of the three panels. Login protection unchanged (middleware untouched); all UI text English. lint/build/test pass.
